post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP via WhatsApp (primary) with SMS fallback. Story 1.1.

On success: 200 with { accessToken, refreshToken } in body AND sets the HttpOnly `chopnow_rt` refresh cookie (Phase B1). The body refreshToken is kept for backwards compatibility while the consumer PWA cuts over from localStorage to cookie storage; new clients should ignore the body and rely on the cookie.

Story 1.2 — returns a new access + refresh pair. Phase B1: prefers the HttpOnly `chopnow_rt` cookie; falls back to body `refreshToken` during the frontend cutover. Old refresh becomes invalid (rotation). Replaying an already-rotated refresh revokes the entire family. Error codes (body.code on 401): refresh_invalid_or_expired, refresh_reuse_detected, user_suspended.
Idempotent: a stale or already-revoked refresh token still clears the cookie + returns 204. Use `/admin/auth/revoke-user` (forthcoming) for "log out of all devices."

post.description:
Story 1.6 / Phase A1. Returns one of two shapes:
  - { stage: "totp_required", challenge, challengeExpiresIn } — admin has TOTP enrolled. Client must POST /admin/auth/2fa within 5 minutes.
  - { stage: "success", accessToken, role, email, expiresIn } — admin does not yet have TOTP enrolled (legacy / first-login). 8h access JWT issued directly. Client should redirect to enrollment.
Error codes (body.code on 401): invalid_credentials, account_locked.

Redeems the challenge from step 1. On success: 8h access JWT (same shape as /admin/auth/login when not 2fa-required). Recovery codes are single-use; consuming one decrements the remaining pool. Error codes: totp_challenge_expired, totp_invalid_code.

post.description: Locks the enrollment + mints 10 single-use recovery codes. Codes are shown ONCE — argon2 hashed at rest, no way to retrieve them later. Admin MUST save them (password manager / printed sheet) before leaving this screen.

info.title: ChopNow API
info.description: Backend HTTP contract for chopnow-app (consumer / livreur / vendeur / admin).

phone.description: Phone number — Cameroon local (e.g. 670000000) or international E.164 (e.g. +33695412820).

cfTurnstileResponse.description: Cloudflare Turnstile response token. Only required when CAPTCHA_ENABLED=true on the server.

refreshToken.description: Refresh JWT. Optional: the HttpOnly chopnow_rt cookie is the preferred source. Body field accepted for backward compatibility while the PWA cuts over.

deviceFingerprint.description: Opaque per-device ID minted by the client (localStorage) so re-subscribes from the same device dedupe

endpoint.description: Push service endpoint URL to deactivate

description.description: Free-form description (e.g. "2ème portail bleu après le transformateur").

phone.description: Delivery phone. Defaults to the user's account phone at order time if unset.

itemId.description: Item UUID (must belong to the same vendor as the cart).

vendorId.description: Target vendor UUID. All cart lines must belong to it.

noteForVendor.description: Note for the vendor — the only client→vendor channel. Max 120 chars.

deliveryPhone.description: Phone the rider will call if lost. E.164 or Cameroon local.

scheduledFor.description: Schedule the order for a future time (vendor must have acceptsPreOrders=true). Omit / null for immediate delivery. v1 supports same-day pre-orders only.

note.description: Optional explanation surfaced to the consumer (max 200 chars).
note.example: Pas de courant depuis 2h, impossible de finir la cuisson.

payerPhone.description: MTN MoMo or Orange Money number — Cameroon local or E.164.

ownerName.description: Nom complet du propriétaire (gérant). Used for KYC + payment receipts.

type.description: Type de vendeur — détermine le badge affiché + le tier KYC.

latitude.description: Latitude WGS84. Captured via the browser geolocation API from the vendor phone. Optional — when absent the service falls back to Douala city center (legacy behavior).

longitude.description: Longitude WGS84. Same source/constraints as latitude.

pointOfReference.example: En face de la pharmacie Sainte-Marie

whatsappPhone.description: WhatsApp phone — Cameroon local or international E.164.

momoPhone.description: MTN MoMo or Orange Money phone — Cameroon local or E.164.

firstItemPriceXAF.description: Prix du premier plat en FCFA (entier, positif).

rccmNumber.description: Numéro RCCM (Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier). Restaurant uniquement.

description.example: La meilleure cuisine de Makepe — plats du jour à partir de 1 500 FCFA.

momoPhone.description: New MoMo number. No OTP-on-new-number confirmation in MVP — admin oversight handles fraud cases at launch.

description.example: Poulet rôti, plantains, légumes du jour.

categoryId.description: UUID d'une MenuCategory du même vendeur.

preparationMinutes.description: Temps de préparation moyen (minutes). Restaurants uniquement.

stockLevel.description: Stock state. Defaults to IN_STOCK on create. Edit later from the menu screen / item editor.

isInStock.description: Legacy fallback — true = IN_STOCK, false = OUT_OF_STOCK.

licensePlate.description: Numéro de plaque (requis pour MOTO et CAR ; optionnel pour BICYCLE ; absent pour ON_FOOT). Lettres majuscules, chiffres et tirets.

code.description: 4-digit pickup or delivery code as shown by the vendor / consumer.

password.description: Min 12 chars, must include uppercase, digit, and special char.

challenge.description: Opaque challenge token returned by /admin/auth/login when totp_required.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP from the authenticator app, OR a recovery code in XXXX-YYYY format.

reason.description: Free-text reason — shown to the vendor/rider in their WhatsApp notification.

acceptsPreOrders.description: Whether the vendor should accept pre-orders.

campayRef.description: Campay transaction reference from the manual fire

riderAction.description: What to do with the rider

vendorCompensation.description: Whether to compensate the vendor for the lost food

consumerRefund.description: Whether to queue a refund to the consumer

note.description: Free-text note captured in refusalReason + audit log
